The '''Regent of Garis''' was a being who visited [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], despite supposedly being allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].
